lines.en: I drop by the cafe to hang out with Haruka but, when I arrive, she’s surprised to see that I approach {i}her{/i} instead of her much younger and much more lesbian employee.
lines.zh: 我去咖啡馆找 Haruka 玩，可等我到了，她看到我径直走向{i}她{/i}、而不是走向她那位更年轻也更百合的员工，显得有些意外。

lines.en: Regardless, she happily accepts the company as she’s been wanting to vent to someone about “adult problems” all week and none of her part-timers really understand them.
lines.zh: 无论如何，她还是很开心有人陪——她想跟人吐槽「大人的烦恼」整整一周了，而她的兼职们没一个真懂。

lines.en: To be honest, {i}I{/i} don’t really understand them either since the vast majority involve cafe operations and I have never attempted either running or opening a cafe at any point in my life.
lines.zh: 说实话，{i}我{/i}也不太懂，因为绝大部分都跟咖啡馆的运营有关，而我这辈子从没试过经营或开一家咖啡馆。

lines.en: I guess there’s a slight chance that I did something like that in the past, but seeing as I am now thinking about it and remaining entirely sentient, it’s probably safe to assume that never happened.
lines.zh: 我想，也许有那么一点点可能我以前做过类似的事，但既然我现在正清醒地思考着这个问题，那大概可以断定那事从未发生过。

lines.en: I think Haruka catches onto my lack of knowledge about cafes as she takes a seat on the couch and begins asking me about how {i}my{/i} life has been lately.
lines.zh: Haruka 大概察觉到了我对咖啡馆一无所知，于是她在沙发上坐下，开始问{i}我{/i}最近过得怎么样。

lines.en: I tell her about how I’m caught in a timeloop with two of my niece’s closest friends and that the secret to the universe might involve me impregnating teenagers.
lines.zh: 我告诉她，我和我 [niece] 最要好的两个朋友一起困在了时间循环里，而宇宙的秘密搞不好跟我让未成年少女怀孕有关。

lines.en: She nods and tells me she knows what it’s like (She doesn’t), and that she’d lend me a hand if there was any way for her to help without being personally impregnated.
lines.zh: 她点点头，说她懂这种感觉（她并不懂），还说如果有什么办法能在不让自己怀孕的前提下帮上忙，她愿意出力。

lines.en: I shrug off her assistance and move onto other topics as I didn’t really expect her to go along with this one anyway but, honestly, I’m glad she did.
lines.zh: 我谢绝了她的好意，转去聊别的话题——反正我本来也没指望她会当真，但说实话，她愿意顺着我说，我还是挺高兴的。

lines.en: I might not be of any help when it comes to hearing {i}her{/i} issues out, but being able to talk about mine to someone who will go along with them rather than ask questions is always a welcome experience.
lines.zh: 在倾听{i}她{/i}的烦恼上我也许帮不上什么忙，但能有个愿意顺着你说、而不是追问的人听你倒苦水，永远都是件好事。

lines.en: Especially when the person I am talking to sneakily unlatches the top button of her shirt every time I walk into the store.
lines.zh: 尤其是那个听你说话的人，每次你走进店里都会偷偷把衬衫最上面的那颗扣子解开。
